Are you passionate about transport and logistics? Bleckmann is looking for you! 

We are looking for logistics employees for Bleckmann Ghent. You will be working in the morning shift (05u48 - 13u48).

This is a temporary assignment during a busy and dynamic peak period. It's a great opportunity to gain experience in logistics. As Bleckmann operates multiple peak periods throughout the year (such as Black Friday in November), you will have the opportunity to return for future assignments.

Are you interested in this opportunity? Be sure to read this vacancy!

Tasks:

• You prepare the orders in order of arrival using a scanning system

We organize bus transport from Ghent to ensure easy access to Bleckmann:  

• Back and forth ride from the station of Gent-Sint-Pieters

• Departure at 5u10

 

• Positive attitude

• Good numerical skills

• Flexibility

• Punctuality

• Fluent in either Dutch, English or French

Do you like to roll up your sleeves? 

And are you looking for a flexible job that fits your lifestyle?

Then SD Worx Jobs is the right place for you

SD Worx Jobs is looking for a logistics associate for a client located in Kruisem. 

Your tasks will be as follows:

• Helping to prepare orders with a scanning system

• Packing goods

• Labelling and marking 

• Performing quality checks

• You speak and understand English.

• Preferably, you have experience as an order picker.

Lead the design, development, and optimization of enterprise applications across back-end and front-end technologies. Architect scalable solutions, apply advanced software design patterns, and mentor junior and medior developers. Utilize the Microsoft ecosystem, modern front-end frameworks, Azure cloud services, messaging platforms, and architectural practices like CQRS, DDD, and Clean Architecture to deliver robust and business-aligned solutions.
Key responsibilities

• Architect and design scalable enterprise applications

• Implement and enforce advanced software patterns (CQRS, DDD, Clean Architecture)

• Design, implement, and maintain MicroServices-based architectures

• Develop clean, secure, and maintainable code across front-end and back-end

• Mentor and coach junior and medior developers, perform code reviews

• Build interactive user interfaces with modern front-end frameworks (Angular, Blazor, React)

• Collaborate with product owners and business analysts to translate requirements into technical solutions

• Implement and optimize containerized solutions with Kubernetes, Docker, or AKS

• Design and integrate distributed systems using messaging Middleware (Azure Service Bus, RabbitMQ, Kafka)

• Leverage Azure services for cloud-native, scalable, and secure solutions

• Ensure CI/CD pipelines, automated testing, and DevOps best practices

Very good knowledge in the following technologies is a plus

• C#

• .NET Core

• ASP.NET Core

• Entity Framework Core

• LINQ

• RESTful API design and integration

• SQL Server

• MicroServices architecture

• CQRS

• DDD

• Clean Architecture principles

• Blazor or Angular

• TypeScript

• JavaScript

• Unit & integration testing

• CI/CD pipelines

• Microsoft Azure

• Kubernetes

• Docker

• AKS

• WPF (XAML) is a plus

• Problem-solving

• Rigorous methodology

Qualifications

• 5+ years in .NET / .NET Core development

• Master's or Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or related field is a plus

• English + French and / or Dutch

Are you passionate about transport and logistics? Bleckmann is looking for you! 

We are looking for logistics employees for the Bleckmann warehouses in Rieme and Desteldonk (near Ghent) to support the Black Friday sale from 16 November until 14 December.. You will be working in the morning shift (05u48 - 13u48).

This is a temporary assignment during a busy and dynamic peak period. It's a great opportunity to gain experience in logistics. As Bleckmann operates multiple peak periods throughout the year, you will have the opportunity to return for future assignments.

Are you interested in this opportunity? Be sure to read this vacancy!

Tasks: 

• Preparing incoming orders

• You prepare the orders in order of arrival using a scanning system

• You prepare the correct documents when packing orders

We organize bus transport from Antwerp to ensure easy access to Bleckmann:  

• Pick up at Sint-Jansplein 

• Departure at 4u30

 

• Positive attitude

• Good numerical skills

• Flexibility

• Punctuality

• Fluent in either Dutch, English or French

We are looking for loaders - unloaders for a leading logistics company specializing in the efficient transportation of goods.

This is an on-call position, where you will be deployed as needed, providing flexibility in your schedule.
This means we can also be flexible for you (for example, if there are certain days you cannot work, we can keep this in mind).

You'll work in a 2 shift system.
One week you'll work from 5h (morning) until 13h (afternoon)
The other week you'll work from 13h (afternoon) until 21h (evening)
- Vaardigheden:
You are flexible
You are able to do physical work 
You can work well in a team
You have your own transportation to get to work on these hours (bike, car, step,..)

- Talenkennis:
English

Inetum is a European leader in digital services. Every day, the Group's 28,000 consultants and specialists aim to make a digital impact for businesses, public sector bodies and society as a whole: solutions that contribute to performance, innovation and the common good.

Present in 19 countries, close to the regions, and with its major software publisher partners, Inetum meets the challenges of digital transformation with proximity and flexibility.

In response to a market that has been growing steadily for over 30 years, Inetum has made the deliberate choice to refocus on 4 core businesses in order to gain strength and offer customized solutions tailored to the specific needs of its customers: consulting (Inetum Consulting), infrastructure and application management (Inetum Technologies), software implementation (Inetum Solutions) and its own software publishing business (Inetum Software). Inetum has forged strategic partnerships with 4 of the world's leading software publishers - Salesforce, ServiceNow, Microsoft and SAP - and is pursuing a dedicated acquisition strategy to become one of Europe's top 5 in these technologies, and offer the best expertise to its customers.

At Inetum Belgium, we offer more than just a job; we provide an inspiring environment and opportunities for growth and development. We strive to create a workplace where you can harness your talents, contribute to challenging projects, and be part of a leading IT consultancy group.

Job Description

Forget about conventional communication styles, the main language we speak is Java. So, If you are looking to upgrade your skills and working on exciting and challenging projects; just scroll down your mouse and learn how you can become the next Java developer Expert Inetum-Belgium is searching for.

As Java developer it will be expected of you:

 
• To share and upgrade your skills through multiple projects ranging from new applications & functionalities developments to complex cross-projects developments. Including elaboration and contribution to maintenance standards.
 
• To share you expertise and exchange about projects status and issues during the Scrum meetings.
 
• To help identify and bring your contribution to key improvements elements of development projects.
 
• To take the lead on the quality of the delivery by playing a proactive role in the testing phases at all the necessary steps of the development.
 
• To ensure the delivery of well designed, testable and efficient code
 
• To coach and help junior profiles on some matters (if you feel comfortable)

Discover your future with inetum belgium

 
• Make a Difference with a Meaningful Career: step into a role where your work truly matters. At Inetum Belgium, you'll have the chance to impact lives and drive meaningful change every day.
 
• Grow and Evolve Professionally: embrace a culture of continuous learning and development. We offer a range of training opportunities designed to help you expand your skills and advance your career.
 
• Unlock Relevant Career Opportunities: pursue the career path you've always dreamed of with tailored opportunities and the IT expertise you need to succeed.
 
• Achieve Work-Life Balance: we value your well-being. Enjoy flexible working hours, the convenience of satellite offices, the comfort of home working, and an informal, no-nonsense environment.
 
• Enjoy Generous Annual Leave: life is more than just work. Take advantage of 32 days of annual leave to relax and recharge.
 
• Travel in Comfort: forget the hassle of commuting. We provide a company car and a national fuel/charging card to keep you on the move. Prefer a different option? You can choose a mobility allowance instead
...

• Experience:

• Proven track record in delivering enterprise-grade applications.

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

• Good knowledge of Hibernate/JPA.

• Experience with REST/SOAP services and XML/JSON integrations.

• Platform & Cloud experience

• Experience with:

• Azure and/or AWS

• Enterprise application servers such as JBoss, WildFly, WebSphere or Oracle Middleware

• Tomcat or similar runtimes

• Application deployment, configuration, and runtime behaviour

• Frontend awareness:

• Familiarity with Angular and/or React

• Ability to collaborate effectively with frontend teams

• Integration & distributed systems:

• Experience with API-driven integrations and messaging patterns

• Understanding of distributed and event-driven architectures

• AI & modern development practices:

• Familiarity with AI-assisted development tools such as GitHub Copilot.

• Basic understanding of AI/ML services and API integrations.

• Ability to assess AI-generated solutions from a quality, security and maintainability perspective.

• Languages:

• Fluent in English

• Dutch and/or French

With a strong international presence, the organization collaborates with policymakers, industry leaders, regulatory bodies, and civil society stakeholders to address evolving economic and societal challenges. Its multidisciplinary approach combines analytical expertise, evidence-based policy development, and constructive dialogue to drive meaningful and lasting impact.

Jobomschrijving

As a Policy Officer your responsibilities are:

• Monitor and analyse European and international policy, regulatory, and market developments relevant to consumers and businesses.
• Conduct research and provide evidence-based analysis on economic, regulatory, and market-related topics.
• Translate complex policy, economic, and regulatory information into clear recommendations and strategic insights.
• Support the development and implementation of advocacy, public affairs, and policy initiatives.
• Build and maintain strong relationships with policymakers, industry representatives, regulatory bodies, and other key stakeholders.
• Represent the organization in meetings, conferences, working groups, and external events.
• Collaborate with cross-functional teams to maximize the impact of policy and advocacy activities.
• Prepare policy papers, briefing notes, position statements, and stakeholder communications.
• Support the planning and execution of stakeholder engagement activities and events.
• Identify emerging trends, challenges, and opportunities, and contribute innovative ideas to strengthen the organization's influence and impact.

A successful Policy Officer should have:

• Master's degree in Economics, Business, Public Policy, Political Science, or a related discipline.
• Relevant experience in public affairs, policy, advocacy, consultancy, regulatory affairs, or a comparable environment.
• Strong understanding of economic and market trends and their impact on consumers and businesses.
• Good knowledge of the European policy and regulatory landscape.
• Excellent analytical, research, and problem-solving skills.
• Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to simplify complex topics for different audiences.
• Proven ability to build relationships and engage effectively with senior stakeholders.
• Confident, proactive, and capable of representing an organization externally.
• Collaborative team player with strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple priorities.
• Fluent in English; additional European languages are considered an asset.
• Innovative and solution-oriented mindset, with the ability to identify opportunities and challenge conventional thinking.

BelPro Chocolate Masters is a growing chocolate manufacturer in Duffel. We are looking for a motivated recent graduate or junior professional who wants to develop practical experience in Quality & Food Safety within a real food-production environment. 

You will work closely with the Operations Manager and experienced external specialists. You will support the development and day-to-day maintenance of our Quality Management System (QMS), HACCP, GMP, hygiene and food-safety activities. 

Your activities will include supporting procedures and quality records, following up quality requirements on the production floor, traceability exercises, internal checks, non-conformities and corrective actions, internal audits, supplier and raw-material documentation, and preparation for future IFS Food certification. 

We are looking for someone with a background in Food Technology, Food Science, Bioscience, Quality, Food Safety or a related field. Previous food-industry experience is an advantage but is not required. 

Good English is important. Dutch is an advantage. 

We offer a practical opportunity to learn, contribute and gradually take on more responsibility as BelPro continues to grow.

• Background in Food Technology, Food Science, Bioscience, Quality, Food Safety or a related field. 

• Basic knowledge of HACCP, microbiology, food safety, quality systems or food processing is an advantage. 

• Structured, practical and willing to learn. 

• Comfortable working both with documentation and on the production floor. 

• Able to communicate and cooperate with production and management. 

• Previous food-manufacturing experience is an advantage, but not required.

You will support the Customer Service team with tasks such as order entry, stock assignment, requests of certificates, etc.

 As you will progress in your training, the responsibilities can be expanded to direct customer support and coordination of the full order to cash process for a selected amount of customers.

• Act as a key point of contact for assigned customers and provide professional and timely support.
• Manage the end-to-end order process, including order entry, verification, delivery coordination and invoicing.
• Maintain accurate customer and order information in the systems.
• Provide customers and Sales colleagues with clear updates on order and delivery status.
• Prepare relevant documentation, including order confirmations, delivery documents and certificates.
• Respond to customer inquiries and help resolve order, delivery, pricing or product-related questions.
• Register and follow up on customer complaints, returns and other order-related issues.
• Work closely with Sales and internal stakeholders to ensure an efficient customer experience.
• Collaborate with colleagues across Customer Service, Supply Chain, Sales, Quality and other departments.
 

• You have experience in Customer Service, Sales Support, Order Management, Administration or a similar environment. 
• You are customer-focused, organized and comfortable managing different priorities and administrative tasks.
• You communicate clearly and enjoy working with customers and colleagues from different countries and cultures.
• You are confident working with Microsoft Excel, Outlook and Teams.
• Experience with SAP or another ERP system is considered a strong advantage.
• You are fluent in English, both spoken and written.
• Knowledge of Russian is an additional asset, but is not required.
• You work accurately, take ownership and enjoy contributing to a collaborative team environment.

You will be a member of our SEM/TEM team. This team is responsible for in-line and out-of-line released electron microscopy inspection.  As a TEM technician you ensure the smooth processing of the various TEM inspections, focusing on the quality of the inspection. 

As SEM/TEM technician you will have the following key responsibilities: 

• You follow-up the inline TEM queue.
• You adjust released recipes for automated TEM inspections.
• You are responsible for (semi)-automated and guided TEM inspections.
• You contribute to achieving targets.
• You help with statistical process control (SPC) on TEM tools. 

• Preferable you have a bachelor’s degree or associate degree (2-year program) in science (chemistry, biology, physics) or equal to experience.
• It would be a great plus if you have hands-on experience with automated metrology or SEM/TEM inspections in the semi-conductor industry.  
• You are a strong planner and you would enjoy working in a fast-paced environment. You certainly know how to multi-task and prioritize assignments.  
• You are a communicative team player with a very good knowledge of both English and Dutch.
• You are prepared to work in a shift system (early/late/night and 1 weekend out of 4).

For our client in the Kortrijk region, we are looking for a motivated Carpet Finishing Operator to strengthen our team on the finishing line.

 

• Cutting and finishing carpets to size

Job Requirements:

We are looking for an experienced and motivated Packaging Supervisor to join the  team on the night shift. 

Your responsibilities:

• Follow and maintain the work schedule

Requirements:

• Strong organizational and leadership skills.

• Ability to work independently and make decisions under pressure.

• Willingness to work night shifts.

• Experience in a food production or manufacturing environment is an advantage.

• Good command of English; knowledge of Dutch is a plus.

Do you have experience in production or a technical background, and are you willing to work in shifts? Do you speak Dutch or English fluently?

• As a Production Worker, you will be responsible for making safety boots.

• You are eager to learn and have a strong focus on quality

For a company in the Tielt region, active in the food industry, we are looking for a motivated and reliable Packaging Operator.

Your responsibilities:

• You like working with vegetables
